diagnostics.message: An expressed or partial requirement needs a real positive goal or supported constraint.

context.allowed: Supply a supported demand or constraint, or retain the remaining gap as retained_only/unmapped.
context.format_example: Status fragments: {"status":"expressed","gaps":[]} requires a supported positive demand or constraint; {"status":"partial"} requires an executable demand or constraint and nonempty gaps; {"status":"retained_only"} requires neither and nonempty gaps. These are fragments, not replacement realizations. Do not invent a demand or remove a supported demand to change status.
